briefdescription.para: Maximum nanoseconds between clock ticks (20 ms).
Minimum number of I/O operations in a single list I/O call.
Maximum number of bytes in a LANG name.
Maximum number of bytes in a message string.
Minimum number of bits needed to represent file size.

detaileddescription.para: Defines minimum, maximum, and runtime-invariant POSIX limits as required by POSIX.1-2017. These constants complement the C standard <limits.h> header and the runtime sysconf()/pathconf() interfaces.
